items.finding: Historical PDF stream contains DeviceRGB 1 0 0 rg / 0 0 1 rg vector paint. NSImage thumbnail + Generic RGB channel thresholds mixed a display-dependent raster with an assumed color space. Direct CGContext page rendering into explicit sRGB RGBA8 fixes that measurement boundary without changing >0.9/<0.1 or >4000 assertions. Historical bytes plus missing-red/missing-blue/missing-image controls pass. Exact past display profile remains unknown; native print acceptance remains pending.
